clue.text: Former PM and girl in a state

parts.note: Lord North was British Prime Minister during the American War of Independence
Carol is a girl's name
taken as written

explanation.surface: A one-time prime minister and a young woman end up in a fluster together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a state' reads as being flustered, but it is IN + A, and the state is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: This is one of the fifty US states, on the Atlantic seaboard.

clue.text: Because it's to be paid later

explanation.surface: An explanation for running up a bill.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both 'by reason of' and 'on credit', as goods bought on a tab.

clue.text: Emperor's new suit exposed after short time

parts.note: T is the standard abbreviation for time, a shortened form

indicators.note: new signals that the letters of the word suit are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: An allusion to the fairy tale of the emperor whose new clothes leave him exposed.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface recalls the fairy tale of the Emperor's New Clothes; 'exposed' only completes that picture, while 'new' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Titus was a Roman emperor of the Flavian dynasty, son of Vespasian.

clue.text: Rodent initially taking cheese off your plate, unusually

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of each of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A rat-like animal surprisingly helps itself to the cheese from your dinner plate.
explanation.definitionFit: The coypu is a large South American water rodent, also called nutria.

clue.text: Remember religious teaching on prayer

indicators.note: in a down entry, on means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: RE is religious education, a school subject in Britain
a collect is a short prayer appointed for a particular day in church liturgy

explanation.surface: A believer is told to commit scripture lessons about prayer to memory.
explanation.definitionFit: To recall something is to bring it back to mind, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Destiny over time, possibly, provided recurrent theme

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters of destiny's synonym and time can be arranged another way

parts.note: lot means one's fate or destiny
provided means if, as in 'provided it rains'

explanation.surface: A musing on fate and time supplying the repeating idea of a work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' is the anagram signal covering both destiny's synonym and time; 'over' is only a link, not a reversal.
explanation.definitionFit: A Wagnerian term for a musical phrase tied to a character or idea that keeps returning.

clue.text: Group performing a number that's square

definitions.text: Group performing a number that's square

parts.words: Group performing a number that's square
parts.note: a band of players whose head-count is a perfect square, namely three times three

explanation.surface: A band playing a tune that is old-fashioned and uncool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'square' looks like slang for unfashionable, but it means a square number: nine is three squared.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical ensemble of nine players, nine being a square number.

clue.text: Musical in which Mae allies with the right person

parts.note: Mae West was a Hollywood film star
to side with someone is to ally with them
a Tory is a British Conservative, a person of the political right

explanation.surface: A show in which the actress Mae joins forces with a conservative.
explanation.definitionFit: Bernstein and Sondheim's 1957 stage show retells Romeo and Juliet in New York.

clue.text: Like many Arabs, in main desert led astray

indicators.note: astray signals the letters of main desert led wander out of order

explanation.surface: Travellers in a great desert are led off course.
explanation.definitionFit: Many Arabs live in the region spanning Arabia, the Levant and Egypt, so the adjective describes them.

clue.text: Stoat beheaded and cut up? Just so!

annotationWithheld.why: Stoat beheaded and cut up? Just so! (7): no synonym for stoat, beheaded and rearranged, gives the letters of the answer; the clue appears garbled as held and a search found no printed version
annotationWithheld.clue: Stoat beheaded and cut up? Just so!

clue.text: One in church opposed to wine

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
anti means against or opposed to

explanation.surface: A churchgoer who is against drinking wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A red wine from the Tuscany region of Italy.

clue.text: Thus pet rejected Mexican food

indicators.note: rejected means turned back, so the two words are read in reverse

parts.note: so means thus
a cat is a common pet

explanation.surface: A pet animal turns its nose up at a Mexican dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Folded tortillas with a filling are a staple Mexican dish.

clue.text: Endless line-I'm cutting into one

indicators.note: cutting into means the letters for line and I'm are placed within the synonym of one

parts.note: united means made one, joined together
I'm written without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: An endless line cuts through something whole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' tempts you to cut the last letter off line, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without limits or bounds has no end.

clue.text: One special unit for people in North America

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: special signals that the letters of unit are made into an unusual arrangement

explanation.surface: A single special forces unit deployed in North America.
explanation.definitionFit: The indigenous peoples of Arctic Canada, Greenland and Alaska.

clue.text: Religious type accepting blame as healer

indicators.note: accepting means taking in, so the word for blame goes inside

parts.note: a theist is a person who believes in God
rap means blame, as in 'take the rap'

explanation.surface: A believer who takes the blame becomes a healer.
explanation.definitionFit: A practitioner who treats illness or mental difficulties is a healer.

clue.text: Score I got in game of cards

parts.note: a score is twenty
I as a Roman numeral is one

explanation.surface: Someone boasts of the points they made in a card game.
explanation.definitionFit: Also called pontoon or blackjack, a casino card game aiming at a count of twenty-one.

clue.text: A new East I rebuilt-being this?

definitions.text: A new East I rebuilt-being this?

indicators.note: rebuilt means the letters of a new east I are reassembled differently

explanation.surface: A self-description by someone from a newly reconstructed Asian nation.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines: being from the island of the 'new East', rebuilt as a modern economy, you are this.
explanation.definitionFit: A person or thing from the island nation off the coast of China, a newly industrialised Asian country.

clue.text: Undetectable, in one sense, in method our lessons used

indicators.note: in signals that the letters are found inside the words method our lessons

explanation.surface: Lessons in a technique taught to make something impossible to notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in one sense' qualifies the definition: undetectable only by smell.
explanation.definitionFit: Having no smell means being undetectable to the nose, one of the five senses.

clue.text: Be introducing new term for fanatic

indicators.note: introducing means bringing something inside, so the anagram goes into the synonym of be

parts.note: to be is to exist

indicators.note: new signals that the letters of term are rearranged

explanation.surface: Advice on bringing in a fresh label for a zealot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Be' looks like a link verb, but it supplies the outer piece, a synonym for exist; 'new' is the anagram signal on term.
explanation.definitionFit: A person holding radical views, a zealot, is a fanatic.

clue.text: Plants I'd exported from Sunshine State

indicators.note: exported from means sent out of, so the letters of I'd leave the state's name

parts.note: the Sunshine State is the nickname of Florida
I'd written without its apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone recalls shipping plants out of Florida.
explanation.definitionFit: The plant life of a region is collectively its flora.

clue.text: What could matter be with nag? She's a shrew

indicators.note: could be signals that the letters of matter and nag might form something else

explanation.surface: A riddle about a nagging woman who is a scold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What could matter be with nag?' asks for MATTER plus NAG rearranged; 'be with' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrew in the old sense is a bad-tempered scolding woman, as in The Taming of the Shrew.

clue.text: College head cut page from book

indicators.note: cut means losing the last letter

parts.note: a rector is the head of some colleges

explanation.surface: The principal tears a page out of a book.
explanation.definitionFit: The right-hand page of an open book is its recto.

clue.text: Opening in theatre, I'm performing in title role

indicators.note: opening in means the first letter of theatre

parts.note: I'm written without its apostrophe
on means performing, as an actor on stage

explanation.surface: An actor boasts of playing the lead at a theatre's opening night.
explanation.definitionFit: Timon of Athens is a Shakespeare play, so its central character takes the title role.

clue.text: Revolutionary killed in bloodbath, so to speak

definitions.text: killed in bloodbath, so to speak

explanation.surface: A rebel slain in a massacre.
explanation.walkthrough: The French revolutionary was stabbed by Charlotte Corday while in his bath, so his bath became bloody.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean-Paul Marat was a radical of the French Revolution murdered in his bathtub in 1793.

clue.text: Like diamonds for a young person

explanation.surface: Gems compared to a child.
explanation.walkthrough: In bridge, diamonds and clubs are the minor suits.
explanation.definitionFit: Diamonds rank as a lower-scoring suit in bridge; a person under legal age is a juvenile.

clue.text: Handle hot stuff, so be less blessed?

explanation.surface: Taking stolen goods carries a moral cost.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hot' is slang for stolen; and the Bible says it is more blessed to give than to take.
explanation.definitionFit: A fence takes in stolen goods; Acts 20:35 says giving is more blessed than taking.

clue.text: Large work unit giving lots of people attention

parts.note: many means a large number of people, as in 'the many'
ear means attention, as in 'lend an ear'

explanation.surface: A big team of workers who listen to many people.
explanation.definitionFit: A measure of labour equal to one person working for twelve months, a large unit of work.

clue.text: Star group, a standard feature down under

explanation.surface: A constellation shown on an Australian flag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'standard' means flag: the constellation appears on the flags of Australia and New Zealand.
explanation.definitionFit: Crux is a constellation of the southern sky and is pictured on Antipodean national flags.
